query: WITH kept AS (INSERT INTO linked_billing_profiles (org_id, provider, client_id, user_profile_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_profile_id) SELECT user_profile_id AS "user_profile_id!" FROM kept UNION ALL SELECT user_profile_id FROM linked_billing_profiles WHERE org_id = $1 AND provider = $2 AND client_id = $3 LIMIT 1
